report:
Any DNS monitor causes crash loop


### Description

After creating any DNS monitor the server crashes. PM2 goes into a reboot-crash loop and the UI isn't accessible to remove the monitor anymore. A manual SQL query in the database needs to be run to remove the offending monitor.

### 👟 Reproduction steps

Add a new DNS monitor for 1.1.1.1 to check www.google.com.

### 👀 Expected behavior

Server keeps running with new DNS monitor

### 😓 Actual Behavior

Crashes

### 🐻 Uptime-Kuma Version

1.23.11

### 💻 Operating System and Arch

OpenBSD 7.4-current

### 🌐 Browser

Firefox

### 🖥️ Deployment Environment

- Runtime: v18.19.1
- Database: sqlite
- Filesystem used to store the database on: FFS2 (openbsd default)
- number of monitors: 3

evidence.quote: Given that there is nothing that we can do to get around this (as platform dependent issue) and following up will have to be done elsewhere I am going to close this issue. (after reporter confirmed: "both the example scripts cause the same crash in my system... I'll follow up with the openbsd node maintainer")

notes: c-ares assertion abort inside the OpenBSD Node.js build, reproduced with plain Node scripts outside Uptime Kuma; not a user setting, deployment config, or app code defect.
